title: Norml Performance Audit
pitch: Measure website performance and turn observed bottlenecks into specific, testable recommendations.
problem: A performance score alone does not identify which asset, request or interaction causes the delay.
The package combines lab and available field evidence with HTTP/HTML and optional source inspection, then states what the data can support.
commands: Run a performance audit of this URL
Compare performance before and after this change

flow.d: Collect both PSI strategies and label field/lab provenance.
Trace HTTP, assets, HTML and optional local source.
Rank evidence-backed bottlenecks without invented gains.
Write specific fixes and comparable validation steps.

items.name: Mobile/desktop audit
items.desc: PSI, HTTP timing, resources and source inspection.

items.name: Field/lab distinction
items.desc: CrUX provenance and honest unavailable measurements.

items.name: Prioritized report
items.desc: Specific fixes tied to resources and verification.

items.name: Guaranteed improvements
items.desc: No promised scores, ranking or timing gains.

items.role: Measured findings, fixes and validation template

items: PSI can be quota limited and CrUX may lack samples.
Lab TBT/FID do not become field INP.
No tool installation, paid usage or fixes occur implicitly.
